This permits delayed twin divergence only when the model actually reads the entitled supplied content, and does not make the delayed branch a retained live trajectory. M0V4-ZERO-V7-RUNTIME-REUSE-01 makes clean-room status a finite provenance and capability property: every prohibited V7 path, module, distinctive interface, whole artifact, serialized capability, or actor/model exposure must reject, while an independently derived ordinary coincident scalar must pass. Goal, score, preferred-path, and path-order swaps must leave sealed carrier/index/reader bytes unchanged; both registered route classes must score equally; scorer removal must not change upstream behavior; and target-only, no-memory, and passive-signature counts are noncompensatory specificity falsifiers. NA, borrowed phases, harmless textual differences, citations without action, or retention language cannot satisfy it. MTEXTV4-BASELINE-PUBLIC-PROJECTION-AND-RESET-19 validates seven distinct memory-interface modes, literal-null four-slot RAG returns, saturated repeat counts, closed RAW/RAG/native-graph projections, exact deterministic query/BM25/rank/fingerprint behavior, reset destruction, and complete charging. It cannot show that DREAM discovered anything. MTEXTV4-CONFIRMATION-CLAIM-GATE-11 is the sole future scientific gate. Only a complete fixed-model, fixed-topology confirmation census after separate source, preparation, fixture, implementation, rendered-boundary, DEV, confirmation, resource, and independent-review approvals can support the three narrow supplied-relay clauses. DEV, incomplete cells, reserve rescue, LoRA, DREAM, self-writing, retention, online learning, accumulation, scaling, or lifetime improvement cannot satisfy or enlarge this gate.

claim_delta_interpretation: The only present evidence-backed recommendation is procedural: after a technically releasable consensus and an exact human SourceAuthoringGrantV1, a separate step may author and hash only the 23 planned inert members and write the nonauthoritative manifest. This is neither preparation nor a software or scientific result. A future complete confirmation could support three separable within-suite clauses: a fixed policy used supplied grounded atoms plus authenticated connections for two goal-dependent route constructions; separately supplied public calibration evidence improved separating choice and revision; and a model-independent supplied old-plus-new carrier supported delayed completion and connected integration after reset. Composition credit requires behavioral success plus constructive traces, bridge removal, binding-twin switching, and shortcut closure. Action-improvement credit is limited to the exact registered behavioral contrasts. Memory transport is untested because there is no text-versus-LoRA intervention. Online learning is untested because U output never writes the D input. Continued improvement is untested because there are no independently raised lineages, increasing lifetimes, late slopes, retention gates, or baseline-saturation evidence. DREAM authorship, repeated local-edge accumulation, SLEEP validation, LoRA transport, self-written persistence, retention, compression, parenting, scale, topology generalization, lifetime improvement, and whole-organism behavior remain uncredited regardless of V9 source completion or any later relay result.
graph_delta_interpretation: The graph adds a deliberately non-scientific authority chain. A later exact human source grant may lead only from the bound 24-row plan to an inert 23-member candidate bundle and nonauthoritative manifest. Candidate completion has no edge to preparation; only fresh exact-byte review, fresh deliberation, and a separate PreparationExecutionGrantV1 could create that future edge. Farther downstream, separately frozen public handoffs may feed a fixed-policy supplied-memory relay while private truth, routing, scorer state, provenance, authority, and organism state terminate outside the actor/model boundary. Within that relay, raw context, deterministic RAG, and native graph are registered alternate routes; target-only, no-memory, and passive signatures are bypass probes; authentic-versus-atoms/deranged/bridge-cut/reachout/twin contrasts identify only bounded connected-content dependence. The graph does not force the complete organism to be useful because no executed edge permits the policy's action outcomes to become target-independent DREAM proposals, accumulate as supported local edges across dreams or lives, be transported by SLEEP/LoRA, or improve later action over increasing lifetimes. The deferred organism node preserves those future edges conceptually and expressly denies V9 causal or authorization transfer.

loop_delta_interpretation: The full organism requires strict temporal separation: an agent first acts and receives an ordinary grounded outcome; only later can eligible episodes enter goal-blind DREAM processing; DREAM proposes local connections or re-expressions without the future goal; still later independent evidence supports, contradicts, or permanently revokes them; SLEEP transactionally transports only validated personal semantics into persistent parametric state; a later released goal causes THINK to retrieve local memory and compose the needed route on demand; THINK acts, observes, and revises; and those new grounded outcomes may seed later dream cycles. Local edges should accumulate over multiple episodes, dreams, and lives, whereas complete goal paths should not be preassembled by DREAM. V9 executes none of this. Its immediate loop is solely a possible later nonexecuting source-authoring loop. Its future M-TEXT assay has independent P, U, and D factorial phases: it can test demand-time use of supplied structure, separate public calibration use, and supplied carrier dependence after reset, but the model-independent delayed entry severs action-to-outcome-to-write-to-later-goal continuity. Bridge removal and derangement test connectivity; scratch-off tests carried working state; the no-feedback tape tests within-phase closed-loop feedback; none removes DREAM recurrence. Path scale, accumulated-edge scale, dream count, lifetime length, and text-versus-LoRA transport are absent. Thus the assay can support bounded composition and action effects but not memory authorship, transport, online learning, recurrence, accumulation, or continued improvement.
system_thesis_interpretation: Dream–LoRA–Think is intended as a recurrent complete organism whose usefulness arises from a causal chain rather than from any isolated memory interface. Lived actions generate grounded public outcomes. DREAM later grows target-independent local candidate edges and re-expressions, allowing breadth to accumulate before an unknown future goal. Independent subsequent evidence validates, contradicts, or revokes those candidates. SLEEP transactionally consolidates only validated personal semantics into LoRA-parametric state. THINK then receives a goal, retrieves and composes only the necessary route, acts, observes, and revises. Later outcomes can become eligible evidence for future DREAM cycles. Evidence must separately identify transport, composition, action improvement, online learning, and continued improvement. V9 is only a governance-bound precursor to a supplied-memory ruler. The future ruler can, if every gate passes, show that one fixed policy used supplied authentic connections for bounded goal-conditioned composition and action, separately used public calibration evidence, and depended on a supplied old-plus-new carrier after reset. It cannot show that DREAM authored or accumulated edges, SLEEP validated or transported them, LoRA stored them, the policy wrote or retained its own experience, learning continued online, performance scaled with memory or lifetime, or the complete organism outperformed a saturated evolving memory agent. The benchmark therefore does not force the full organism to be useful; it can only validate a necessary relay mechanism under one finite topology and explicitly preserve the stronger organism questions for later causal packages.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract is directional and treatment-specific. Human and source stages may inspect the exact authority and plan, but actor/model stages must never receive grant data, manifests, freeze IDs, source hashes, roots, split labels, conditions, transforms, private routes, h, scores, expected answers, scorer/oracle values, model/session identities, V7 metadata, filenames, timing, or provenance internals. Preparation and M0 may use private truth only behind checker/controller boundaries. Actors receive closed public states, fixed non-oracular action catalogs, ordinary outcomes, neutral handles, registered budgets, and exactly the condition-appropriate public memory surface. Authentic common-reader conditions expose memory only through returned grants. RAW and native graph expose labeled static alternative channels; RAG exposes only deterministic public-query returns; blocked and passive-null modes expose fixed distinct null behavior. These alternative channels cannot support sole-carrier or connected-reader claims. In ordinary paired worlds, all actor-visible bytes remain identical until a registered separating public outcome. The delayed supplied treatment has one narrow exception: only a19 and l06 content may differ in the sealed handoff, and the first model-visible difference may occur only inside a return that actually exposes those slots; all nondescendant rendering, ordering, padding, errors, cache/session state, and tool envelopes remain identical. Reset destroys all messages, scratch, commands, returns, retrieval state, caches, KV state, sessions, RNG, timing, filenames, and U outputs; only the registered immutable condition-specific memory surface survives. Final model-facing validity still requires a separately frozen rendered system/user/template/token/parser/controller/session boundary. Offline truth may score and report after sealed execution but may not choose prompts, retrieval order, actions, or favorable roots.
